mods.name: Minepiece QoL
mods.description: Client-side QoL overlays and parsers for play.minepiece.net.

releases.notes:
Four new helpers, each with its own on/off switch, and the mod's chat translation removed now that the server translates chat itself.

**Install:** Minecraft Java 26.2, Java 25+, Fabric Loader 0.20.1+, Fabric API 0.161.0+26.2. Put `minepieceqol-2.2.2+mc26.2.jar` in your `mods` folder and remove any older version of this mod.

## Safe-ready alert
- A chat line in the safe's color (for example *Green safe is ready (spawn 3)*) and a ping when a Marineford safe's lock timer runs out.
- Safes that were already Ready when you joined stay quiet.
- Switch: **Combat › Combat settings**.

## Next job level
- The Jobs panel shows `Next level: ~42m` under the job you're grinding, from your XP of the last five minutes.
- It hides after two minutes without XP.

## Session summary
- `/mpsession`: this session's time, money and money per hour, auction sold and bought, combat and job XP, bosses killed and safes picked.
- `/mpsession last`: the previous session, also posted in chat a few seconds after you join.
- Switch: **Progress › Progress › Session**.

## Auction price memory
- Each auction tooltip adds the lowest listing seen this week and how the server average moved this week, for example *Lowest this week: 1.2K/item (2d ago) · Average ▲ +12% this week*.
- Prices are remembered per item for two weeks.
- Switch: **Economy › Auction house**.

## Also in this release (from 2.2.1)
- The Marineford safes panel marks the spawn you're on and lists spawns and safes by their soonest timer.
- Saved safe spawns are managed under **Combat › Marineford safes**.

## Removed
- Chat translation: the Language page and `/mptranslate`. The server now translates chat itself.

173 automated tests and the client smoke test pass.

mods.name: Minepiece QoL
mods.description: Client-side QoL overlays and parsers for play.minepiece.net.

releases.notes:
A redesigned menu and HUD in the same Minepiece navy and gold, plus picture zoom, auction house price colors and saved Marineford safe timers.

**Install:** Minecraft Java 26.2, Java 25+, Fabric Loader 0.20.1+, Fabric API 0.161.0+26.2. Put `minepieceqol-2.2.0+mc26.2.jar` in your `mods` folder and remove any older version of this mod.

## Menu
- Title bar showing where you are (group › page) and the version, icons on the sidebar groups, and a **Find a setting** search box.
- Page tabs instead of ‹ › arrows, and on/off switches on the right of each setting.
- Settings grouped into titled sections, each switch with a one-line description, in all 9 languages.
- A footer with the save and back keys.

## HUD
- **Color ribbon panels:** each header is a strip in the panel's own color. The per-panel HUD color setting still changes it.
- Darker panel bodies (default HUD opacity 88%, was 72%; a value you set yourself is kept).
- Values lined up on the right and colored by meaning: green for money and XP coming in, red for money going out, amber for a paused grind, grey when unknown.

## HUD editor
- Snap to grid with center guides (hold Shift to move freely).
- Toolbar with Auto-arrange, Undo (also Ctrl+Z), Reset all, a Panels list and Done.
- A label with the selected panel's position and size, and no background blur.

## Pictures
- Zoom any picture with the mouse wheel in the HUD editor, up to covering the whole screen.
- Full-screen mode, fade-out toward any edge, and random rotation through a folder of pictures on a timer.

## Auction house
- Listings colored in 10% steps: green when cheaper, yellow to red when pricier; nothing within ±5%.
- Stronger slot colors, a deal line in each tooltip (for example *Great deal · step 6 of 10*), and a **Price key** box beside the auction house (can be turned off).

## Marineford safes
- A HUD panel with the lock timers of all six safes, color-coded and grouped by spawn.
- Timers are saved through restarts until you press **Reset safe timers** (Progress › Pass and pets).
- `/mpsafes` shows what the mod reads above each safe.

186 automated tests and the client smoke test pass.

readmeSummary: 2.2.0 brings together the redesign from 2.1.4 to 2.1.8: a restyled menu with search, sections and setting descriptions; color ribbon HUD panels with darker bodies and colored values; a new HUD...
